messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: New options for plot_BioGeoBEARS_results()
parts:
Hi all,

I have added some new options to plot_BioGeoBEARS_results().  These help with the problems that can arise with very large plots (e.g., hundreds of tips, or many areas).

simplify_piecharts:
If TRUE, with piecharts, just plot one slice for the maximum probability, 
and white for "other". This should help with large plots with many ranges, 
which can overwhelm some graphics programs (imagine 1000 slices per piechart,
times 1000+nodes). Default FALSE.

tipboxes_TF:
Plot the tip boxes (tip states)?  Default TRUE.

tiplabel_adj:
Justification for tiplabel boxes (same as "adj" parameter 
of text()). Default is c(0.5). Left justification: c(0). Right: c(1). 
Justification top left: c(0,0), etc.

no.margin:
Same as in plot.phylo. Default is FALSE (meaning yes, 
there will be margins).

xlims:
Same as in plot.phylo x.lim. Default is basically c(0,treeheight), so
if tiplabels are getting cut off, try e.g. xlims=c(0,1.5*treeheight).

ylims:
Same as in plot.phylo y.lim. Default is basically c(0,numtips), so
if the spacing between the title and time axis and the tree are too big,
try e.g. ylims=c(0+10,numtips-10). Trial and error will get you there. 
See: https://stat.ethz.ch/pipermail/r-sig-phylo/2013-March/002540.html

Cheers!
Nick
